criterionRegistry.text: Opening an Item with saved Reference audio re-reads Anki and plays its current clip from /api/media in a labelled Reference audio card; an Item without audio shows no play control.
Regenerate audio is an explicit Preview that shows Current vs Preview; Keep current discards the Preview and leaves the Item and its audio unchanged.
After Use preview, Save changes uploads the exact previewed MP3 with audio=replace under the existing ItemId; nothing is written before Save.
Removing audio stays local as an unsaved change until Save changes, which sends audio=remove with no audio file.
Editing the Target of an Item with audio shows "Audio no longer matches the text." with Regenerate audio, and Save changes still succeeds with audio=keep.
Save with audio=remove on an existing Item clears its Audio field and then deletes the superseded managed media, in AD-6 order under one Anki lock.
A failed note write during removal stops before any media deletion and preserves the previous Audio field and media.
A superseded-media cleanup failure after a successful note write reports an error without rollback, a retry succeeds, and Setup reports the leftover clip as a repairable orphan.
Changing Voice on Item detail never synthesizes or writes Anki; only the explicit Regenerate audio action requests a Preview, and it writes nothing.
A failed Save changes retains the edits and the pending audio change, and retry resends the same audio intent and bytes.
A failed audio Preview on Item detail shows "Couldn't make the audio. Current audio is unchanged." and keeps the current clip playable.
